{{Quote|Here's where you can find the Cobral hideout. Go out there and give them everything you've got!|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|A commoner|Rori}}</ref>}}
The '''Cobral Hideout''' was a fortified bunker located a short distance south of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Restuss]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|A small-time gang of thieves, the Cobral. Their hideout can be found on Rori. Unfortunately, I have little information to give you about them. Search their hideout and find any data connected to the exchange of Jabba's assassin into Imperial hands.|[[Yondalla]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Y">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Yondalla"}}</ref>}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the base was the headquarters of the [[Neo-Cobral]] space pirates,<ref name="SWG:CH" /> a gang of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Black marketeer|dealers]] who once controlled the planet [[Frego]].<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref> The Neo-Cobrals had forged [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] documents to get a hold of this fortress.<ref name="SWG:AC" />

[[File:CobralHideoutInterior.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Neo-Cobral Boss inside the hideout.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a commoner in [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] intended to recruit adventurers to assault the Cobral Hideout and eliminate the [[Cobral Overlord]] who was seeking the domination of the moon.<ref name="SWG:AC" />

The same year, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] dispatched an assassin to eliminate the scientist leading the [[Kahmurra Biogenetic Research Station]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] but the assassin failed in his mission and was captured. Jabba's lieutenant [[Yondalla]] later recruited a spacer to recover a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] prisoner transfer document in the Kahmurra Biogenetic Research Station.<ref name="SWG:Y" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cobral Hideout was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG:CH" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
